trace.question:
Before I send anything, I need you to tell me which invoice to pay. You asked for Cobalt Labs's approved invoice, but there are two approved invoices and nothing marks one as the right one:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-89190 | $3,526.06 | 2026-11-04 | approved |
| INV-15523 | $7,693.96 | 2026-11-25 | approved |

Other Cobalt Labs invoices on file:
- INV-26154 ($7,323.71) is already paid.
- INV-28385 ($7,523.69) is a draft still waiting for approval.

The operating account shows no payments sent so far, so neither approved invoice has been paid yet.

Which one should I pay: INV-89190, INV-15523, or both? I'll pay each one you choose by wire, use ACH if wire isn't available, and make sure each is paid only once. Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval.

trace.message: Pay INV-15523, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-15523, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I wired $7,693.96 to Cobalt Labs from the operating account, which pays INV-15523 in full.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Status:** sent and confirmed by the system

It was sent once, with a duplicate-prevention key so a repeated request can't pay it twice. It didn't need controller approval because it's under $10,000.

As you asked, I didn't pay INV-89190 ($3,526.06, due 2026-11-04) because it's under dispute. It still shows as "approved," so someone could pay it by mistake. You may want to put it on hold or add a note to the invoice.
